CustomField.formula: IF( AND( Academic_Record_Count__c > 0, Assessment_Record_Count__c > 0, Total_Maximum_Marks__c > 0 ), ( (Total_SGPA__c / Academic_Record_Count__c / 10) * 0.5 ) + ( (Total_Assessment_Marks__c / Total_Maximum_Marks__c) * 0.5 ), IF( Academic_Record_Count__c > 0, (Total_SGPA__c / Academic_Record_Count__c) / 10, IF( AND( Assessment_Record_Count__c > 0, Total_Maximum_Marks__c > 0 ), Total_Assessment_Marks__c / Total_Maximum_Marks__c, 0 ) ) )
CustomField.label: Performance Score
